comparison.objective: Unlid, orient, insert a plate into a reader, and close its door; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Lid removal, keyed planar orientation, reader placement, and door closure versus recessed tool engagement and iterative mechanical adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Correct corner orientation, lid removed, reader shut versus two safe repeatable impacts. Plate pose and door thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Loading an oriented plate does not exercise parameter tuning or setting retention.
